args.request: Repair review status parsing for the actual documented Jev verification schema: jev_verify emits per-claim actions and no top-level action. Derive an aggregate only after validating complete claim identities, verdicts, action values and confidences. Retain fail-closed rejection for malformed, mismatched, contradicted or operational-error receipts and independent escalation policy. Original recorded judge results remain immutable. Add regression and negative controls for this real output format.
